research_question: How reliable are off-policy estimators for real logged recommendation data, and can a transparent lower-confidence-bound rule prevent unsupported promotion of a learned challenger policy?

source.source_policy: Use only the official ZOZO Research Open Bandit Dataset release. Do not substitute mirrors or synthetic data for the primary empirical result.

estimand_benchmark.target_probability: 1 / n_actions for every action at the leftmost recommendation position
estimand_benchmark.reference_value: Empirical CTR of independently logged Random-policy observations restricted to the same evaluation time window
estimand_benchmark.reference_interpretation: The Random-policy CTR is an on-policy reference estimate with sampling uncertainty, not an exact population ground truth.
primary_error_metrics: absolute estimation error relative to the on-policy reference
relative estimation error when the reference CTR is positive

temporal_design.split_rule: Chronological split after filtering campaign=all and position=1. No random row split.
temporal_design.random_reference_window: Restrict Random-policy observations to timestamps within the BTS evaluation interval.
temporal_design.no_leakage: Reward-model fitting and challenger-policy construction use BTS training observations only. All OPE estimates and promotion decisions use the later BTS evaluation interval only.

reward_model.features: User features plus item-context features and the action-specific user-item affinity available at decision time.
reward_model.preprocessing: Fit all encoders/scalers on the BTS training interval only. Numeric inputs may be standardized; categorical inputs may be one-hot encoded. Missing-value handling must be deterministic and fitted on training only.
reward_model.purpose: Estimate q(x,a)=P(click=1|x,a) for Direct Method, Doubly Robust evaluation, and the frozen challenger policy.
forbidden: No deep neural reward model in the primary analysis.

ope_estimators.invalid_support: Any non-finite or non-positive logged propensity is a hard failure.

challenger_policy.construction: For each context choose the action with highest training-fitted q_hat with probability 1-epsilon, and mix uniformly across all actions with total probability epsilon.
challenger_policy.tie_break: Lowest item_id among exact q_hat ties.
challenger_policy.policy_freeze: Model coefficients, preprocessing state and epsilon are fixed before the BTS evaluation interval is read for policy value.

uncertainty.method: paired moving-block bootstrap over chronologically ordered evaluation rows
uncertainty.paired_difference: DR challenger value minus observed BTS mean reward on the same evaluation resample

required_conditions: Lower endpoint of the 95% bootstrap interval for challenger-minus-BTS value is strictly greater than zero.
Challenger importance-weight ESS fraction is at least 0.10.
All executable provenance and overlap checks pass.
promotion_rule.reporting: Report the decision regardless of sign. Do not tune epsilon, reward model, split, or estimator after seeing the evaluation result.

secondary_analyses.rule: Secondary analyses cannot replace the primary campaign=all, position=1 conclusion.

scientific_boundaries: Clicks are an engagement outcome, not revenue or long-term welfare.
The real-world benchmark evaluates OPE under the support and logging policies present in the Open Bandit Dataset.
The independently logged Random CTR is a reference estimate, not an exact counterfactual truth for every context distribution.
No claim of causal generalization beyond the logged recommendation environment.
No reinforcement-learning claim: the primary project is contextual one-step policy evaluation and selection.
No policy is described as safe merely because its point estimate is larger.
